    Polynomial bounds on occurrences of a module in projective presentations #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_polynomial_vanishing_at_presentation_occurrences (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] {ι : Type v} [Fintype ι] (P₁ P₀ M : FGModuleCat R) [Module.Projective R ↑P₁] [Module.Projective R ↑P₀] (b : Module.Basis ι k (P₁ ⟶ P₀)) :
    ∃ (D : MvPolynomial ι k), D ≠ 0 ∧ D.totalDegree ≤ homFinrank k P₁ M ∧ ∀ (p : P₁ ⟶ P₀) (q : P₀ ⟶ M), CategoryTheory.Epi q → CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp p q = 0 → (∃ (g : M ⟶ TwoTerm.nakayamaKernel k (TwoTerm.ofDifferential p)), g ≠ 0) → (MvPolynomial.eval ⇑(b.repr p)) D = 0

    A module can occur as a quotient of the cokernel with a nonzero map to the Nakayama kernel only on the zero set of a polynomial of bounded degree.
